about_the_game:
Overview: Welcome to "Flower Escape," an enchanting 2D pixel art cooperative puzzle game designed for two-player local gameplay. In this unique world, you and a friend will take on the roles of a witch and a cat, working together to overcome challenges, survive, and reach the symbolic rose to unlock the next exciting level. The game is currently in development, but already offers thrilling cooperative fun.

Key Features:

  • Two-Player Co-op: Collaboration is key to success in "Flower Escape." One player controls the witch (using arrow keys), while the other controls the cat (using WASD keys). You must work closely together, utilizing each character's abilities to solve puzzles and evade dangers.

  • Puzzle Experience: At the heart of the game are its cleverly designed puzzles. Each level is filled with challenges that require strategic thinking and precise execution, testing your teamwork and intellect.

  • Pixel Art Style: The game features a classic pixel art aesthetic, creating a nostalgic yet captivating visual experience that immerses players in the adventure.

  • Core Gameplay: Your objective in each level is to stay alive and, through interactions (press [Shift] key) and pausing (press [R] key), eventually reach the rose. Successfully reaching the rose will unlock and grant access to the next, more challenging level.

  • Multi-Platform Support: The game supports Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems, allowing more players to experience this unique cooperative puzzle game.
